# TemporalCoding

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
A coding scheme in spiking networks where information is represented by the precise timing of spikes rather than their rate. Enables high temporal resolution and low-latency processing, critical for real-time in-network neuromorphic applications.
